authenticity.evidence: There is a real product. The website (https://buttbrain.app/) and the X account @buttbrainer both describe an AI mass-deployer and launchpad, and the site lists this exact CA. GMGN shows the linked X account has launched 306 tokens, which fits the product. There are also strong signs of promotion and bots. 150 DexScreener boosts are active (paid). GMGN counts are 1,000 bundler wallets and 1,000 fresh wallets (both look capped), a 60% bot/degen rate and a 19.7% top-bundler share. GMGN also tags 87 smart wallets and 4 renowned (KOL) wallets. About 7,100 unique buyers in 6h points to broad retail participation, not just wash trading.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts, so I cannot judge how organic the KOL coverage is. Telegram and Discord are invisible to me.

structured_output.counterargument: The story fits the current meta well: an AI agent that launches pump.fun coins, earns fees and creates reflexive attention every time it deploys. This is the canonical token, it has about 7k holders and has done about $2.6M of volume in 2h, and the ATH was only about 2h ago at about $807k. That means a 2x to about $450k is just a retest of an area the market already reached. With 87 smart wallets and 4 KOL wallets involved, one viral post or a visible fee-revenue milestone could send it back there quickly. The -25% m5 move could simply be a dip that gets bought.

structural_risks: Liquidity is about $46k against a ~$220k mcap. The pool is thin, so it can move sharply in either direction
GMGN shows bundler and fresh-wallet counts at their 1,000 cap, a 60% bot/degen rate and a 19.7% top-bundler share
A 4-wallet transfer insider network was detected
Price is down about 70% from the ~$807k ATH, momentum is negative and volume is decaying (h1 is about 44% of the h6 hourly average)
The LP is burned (lp_burn_ratio 1.0), so a classic LP pull is unlikely. The main death risk is a slow bleed

narrative.description: Buttbrain is an 'autonomous butt brain' AI agent that mass-deploys pump.fun tokens, learns from each launch and works as a launchpad that pays 90% of creator fees to the user. It is part of the AI-agent/launchpad meta.
narrative.why_spreading: The AI-agent launchpad angle, which is novel and funny, is getting paid DexScreener boosts and KOL/smart-wallet participation. It hit about $807k ATH within about 2h of launch and drew many copycat tokens.

source_coverage.notes: The X profile page returned HTTP 402, so only search snippets of the bio were available. The site confirms the CA. The live DexScreener API at about 02:22Z showed mcap $218k and m5 -25%. No news, Reddit or Telegram coverage was found. The KuCoin '$BRAIN' article is about an unrelated neural project.

structured_output.thesis: This is the canonical and first Buttbrain token, listed on the project site, and it has a real, meta-fitting AI launchpad story. But it already peaked at about $807k, is now about $220k and falling (m5 -25%, m30 -28%), and volume is decaying. The bundler/bot-heavy wallet makeup and paid boosts point to a pump that is fading after the peak. A 2x means reclaiming about $450k within 6h, which needs a fresh catalyst. That is possible given the narrative, but less likely than a further bleed toward -50%.

token_connection.why_this_token: buttbrain.app lists this exact CA, and it is the earliest pair (created before all the copycats).
token_connection.competing_tokens: About 10 same-name BRAIN copycats were created later. Several show zero liquidity with absurd mcaps, and a few show suspicious multi-million h1 volume on non-pump pools (probably wash trading or scams). There is also an unrelated $BRAIN neural-bridge project.

structured_output.what_is_happening: BRAIN is a pump.fun token for Buttbrain, an AI agent that mass-deploys memecoins. It migrated about 2h ago and ran to about $807k mcap, then retraced about 70% to about $220k. Right now it is dumping about 25% in 5 minutes on decaying volume, while copycat same-name tokens swarm around it.
